title: 数独助手
subtitle: 数独 · 24 点
prompt: Create one professional Android TV app icon graphic. Square composition. A single bold, large, instantly recognizable emblem centered, occupying about 72 percent of the canvas. Refined soft 3D satin material, simple broad shapes, restrained highlights, extremely clean silhouette, legible from across a living room. Straight-on view with gentle depth. No surrounding rounded-square badge, no border, no device mockup, no tiny ornament, no neon, no labels or words, no watermark. Entire canvas has one perfectly flat solid-color background, edge to edge, without a floor or horizon; the emblem may cast a very soft shadow. Background deep blue-purple #2A2454. Emblem: a single ivory square three-by-three number puzzle board with broad indigo divisions and just three large numerals 1, 2, 3 in separate cells. A single golden tile is slightly lifted at the lower right. Clean calm puzzle app, no scattered numbers, no neon glow, no casino style.
